# iOS deletes an event with If-Match: a wrong ETag is 412 and nothing goes.
@seed calendar privat 6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics dentist.ics

> DELETE /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
> If-Match: {etag:weekly-team.ics}
< status 412

> DELETE /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
> If-Match: W/{etag:dentist.ics}
< status 412

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 200
< body dentist.ics

> DELETE /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
> If-Match: {etag:dentist.ics}
< status 204

> GET /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 404

> DELETE /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/6D3B0C8E-5F21-4A77-B0C4-1E9D2A7F3B55.ics
> Auth: alex
< status 404

# The calendar stays.
> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
